author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before reduced the three pills to bare stroke dashes, so it read as a menu or align icon. Now there are three outlined pills (r4 caps), staggered right-left-right as in the reference, and the middle pill ends in a full circle whose left arc forms the concave divider.
omissions: Pills are 8 tall rather than the reference's 12 (three pills plus two 8-unit gaps fill the 40-unit height).
